title: Make the Rust gate invocation explicit and verifiable on Windows
outcome: During /review-changes on Windows, invoking scripts/test-rust.sh directly from PowerShell returned exit 0 with no banner or Cargo output because Windows dispatched the .sh file association instead of executing it. Invoking bash scripts/test-rust.sh did execute the wrapper but failed at line 60 with cargo: not found because non-login WSL does not include /home/greg/.cargo/bin, while bash -lc does. This can falsely pass or block the required review gate depending on invocation shape. Provide a documented/cross-platform launcher or make the Windows invocation fail visibly unless the wrapper and Cargo suite actually execute.
acceptance: From PowerShell, the supported Rust gate command executes the wrapper, prints its fd/thread banner, finds the configured Rust toolchain without relying on an implicit interactive PATH, propagates Cargo test failures, and cannot return success without running the suite. Add a focused launcher/smoke check for the Windows path.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 4, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The Rust gate invocation is explicit on Windows: scripts/test-launcher.mjs:150-159 resolves Git for Windows bash (same ground as the closed w-21bd4d2dda97).
